steps.name: Show pizza dough pls
positives: A plain and empty pizza base or dough is clearly visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add ham
positives: Slices of ham are evenly distributed on the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add mushrooms
positives: Mushrooms are evenly distributed on the whole surface of the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no], Answer No if all the mushrooms are in centered in the middle
negatives: Mushrooms are centered in the middle on the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add oregano
positives: At least multiple green organo leaves are clearly visible on top of the pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]
